meta.name: Panchayat S02
meta.description:
Panchayat is a comedy-drama, which captures the journey of an engineering graduate Abhishek, who for lack of a better job option joins as secretary of a panchayat office in a remote village of Uttar Pradesh. Stuck between crazy villagers and a difficult village lifestyle Abhishek starts his job with the sole motivation of getting out of there as soon as possible, for which he even prepares for CAT.

Rated TV-14 · Returning Series · First aired 5 Mar 2020 · India · Language: Hindi · 30 min
Studio: The Viral Fever · Network: Prime Video

videos.title: Naach
videos.overview: Abhishek tries to save a deal derailed by an overenthusiastic Manju Devi. Prahlad and Vikas struggle with their doubts about Abhishek and Rinki.

videos.title: Bol Chaal Band
videos.overview: Due to lagging village development work, a political opposition starts to emerge against Pradhan Ji. Abhishek's loyalty gets tested.

videos.title: Kranti
videos.overview: Abhishek gives pace to the village development work. But not without hindrance.

videos.title: Tension
videos.overview: On a slow office day Abhishek and Vikas find themselves in an unusual situation. It's a big day for Pradhan's family.

videos.title: Jaise Ko Taisa
videos.overview: Political opposition against Pradhan's family takes its final shape. Abhishek picks a side, loud and clear.

videos.title: Aukaat
videos.overview: A desperate Pradhan Ji makes an attempt to full-fill his biggest election promise. Abhishek gets a reality check, but in a harsh way.

videos.title: Dost Yaar
videos.overview: Abhishek questions his importance in Pradhan's team. Pradhan Ji and Manju Devi have their own dilemmas.

videos.title: Parivaar
videos.overview: Afraid of losing the perception battle to his political opponent Pradhan Ji makes a tough call. An upset Abhishek tries to emotionally detach himself from the people around.
